name: Akfen Yenilenebilir Enerji A.S.
summary: Akfen Yenilenebilir Enerji A.S. together with its subsidiaries, generates and sells electricity from renewable sources in Turkey. The company operates a portfolio of wind and hybrid solar power plants with a total installed capacity of 536.37 megawatts; hydroelectric plants with a capacity of 228.7; and solar power plants with an installed capacity of 121.4 megawatts. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Ankara, Turkey. Akfen Yenilenebilir Enerji operates as a subsidiary of Akfen Holding Anonim Sirketi.
